build.beforeDevCommand: npm run sidecar:prepare && npm --prefix ui run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run sidecar:prepare -- --release && npm --prefix ui run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:
